description: This file defines the main React component for a Tic Tac Toe game, managing game state, rendering child components, and implementing game logic such as turn management and winner calculation.

methods.name: calculateGameResult
methods.description: Determines the game result: 'X', 'O', 'draw', or null for ongoing game based on current board state.

methods.name: getNextPlayer
methods.description: Returns the next player ('X' or 'O') based on the current board state, assuming turn alternation.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the game state, rendering child components, and handling user interactions.
